mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `users` (LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, NAME, NICKNAME, EMAIL, BIRTH_DATE, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{birthDate}, #{profileImageUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, LOGIN_ID AS loginId, PASSWORD AS password, NICKNAME AS nickname, NAME AS name, EMAIL AS email, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS profileImageUrl, USER_ROLE AS userRole, USER_STATUS AS userStatus, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, BIRTH_DATE AS birthDate, LAST_LOGIN_AT AS lastLoginAt FROM `users` WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}

SELECT USER_ID AS userId, LOGIN_ID AS loginId, PASSWORD AS password, NICKNAME AS nickname, NAME AS name, EMAIL AS email, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS profileImageUrl, USER_ROLE AS userRole, USER_STATUS AS userStatus, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, BIRTH_DATE AS birthDate, LAST_LOGIN_AT AS lastLoginAt FROM `users` WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE `users` SET PASSWORD = #{password}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
UPDATE `users` SET PROFILE_IMAGE_URL = #{profileImageUrl}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
